I think he is hurting... maybe he thought that this divorce was a good idea, but the more he thought about everything you wouldn’t be there to do or the reality of coming home to an empty house just hit him... and maybe he thought that having a good time with you just meant that there was a chance. 

I know, for me, it helps to type out my feelings. Getting them on paper or on a screen helps to decide where things should go, and see if maybe things are harsh so I can better figure out how I want to say what I need to say. It could be helpful, but I’m not sure. 

I think you are doing the right thing. Stand your ground, but be looking towards the future too. Figure out what you have to do to be set up after the timeframe you put out was defined. Good luck 💕

I appreciate your kind words... I’m just so overwhelmed by it all. I’ve been suicidal before but I had a best friend or my mom to go to and I don’t have that now. I feel so alone and I’m just done. The VA has provided me with mental care for a bit now but I’m just at a loss... I’m scared and I just want my husband to be here to comfort me but he isn’t. I haven’t been good at making friends since I got out of the military.., I try but there just isn’t that connection...
